text:
Elena (Mktg): Quick ask — mini launch bundle for next week. Need these in drafts within 24h: 1) benchmark micro-grid (mobile-first) 2) two social card sizes with two CTA copies 3) webinar hero + 1-slide summary 4) email header (light/dark) 5) editable inbound routing diagram 6) 1-page brand/localization checklist. Keep copy short and mobile-friendly.

Ravi (Design): Can do. Clarify: benchmark grid — sparklines + three columns (Latency p50, Cost/1k, 1-line Quality note)?

Elena (Mktg): Yes to sparklines and those three columns. Limit to 10 words per row. Social sizes: 1200x628 + 1080x1080.

Sam (Growth): Add CTA variants for A/B: "See the numbers" and "Compare latency & cost". Provide isolated CTA layer/component in Figma.

Nina (PMM): Use v2 palette, avoid saturated gradients. Legal: no competitor logos/names; anonymize models ("Model A"). Include alt-text and contrast ratios in checklist.

Jorge (Legal): Also add small benchmark disclaimer: "Representative workloads; results may vary."

Ravi (Design): Deliverables: Figma page link + PNG/PNG2x exports + SVG diagram + PDF checklist. Specs: micro-grid row 36px mobile, sparklines 56x10, font Inter. ETA drafts 24h, final 48h.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder — upload to /shared/launch-assets/4987654321/ and tag "benchpack-4987". Set marketing+design view/edit.

Elena (Mktg): Thanks — ping me and @Sam when drafts are up. :sparkles:
